Name: Odessa the Researcher
Dialogue: Contracts, blueprints, half-burnt diagrams — bring me paper and I'll bring you power.
Every contract has a name I can put to it. Some of them even show up sober.
A blueprint is just a promise until someone builds the thing.
The wagon crews pay well for good escorts. I take a finder's fee, naturally.
Fire solves most engineering problems. Causes a few, too.
